mission.title: Exile Extermination

phase.briefing:
Greetings, {player}. An Exile named Angol has been executing attacks against our potential redpill recruitment efforts. We need this Exile's existence put to an end.
Head to this location and find Angol. Eliminate him at all costs. The best of luck to you, Warrior.

done.say: That's a confirmed kill. Tyndall should be pleased.

near.say: Good news, {player}. Our target is alone and unaware. Complete your objectives and exit.
How did you find me? Get out of here!

mission.finish:
Excellent, professional work. I see that it will be a pleasure working with you, {player}.
Contact me when you are ready for your next assignment, Warrior.
